component.name: SlowRAW
component.summary: Local photo catalog and non-destructive RAW image editor

description.p: SlowRAW combines a local SQLite photo catalog with GPU-accelerated RAW editing on Windows, macOS and Linux.

ul.li: Metadata search, combined filters, albums and smart groups.
Kelvin white balance, highlight recovery, curves, masks and source-based healing and cloning.
JPEG, PNG and TIFF export with selectable PNG and TIFF bit depths.
